Short title, extent and commencement

ORDINANCE XXXVI OF 1997
ORDINANCE XXXVI OF 1997
EXCHANGE RISK COVERAGE ORDINANCE,
1997
An Ordinance to provide for foreign
exchange risk cover to certain loans
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 15th February, 1997]
No. F.2(1)/97‑Pub., dated 14‑2‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient to provide
for foreign exchange risk cover to loans in foreign currency and for matters
connected therewith and ancillary thereto;
And whereas the National Assembly is
not in session and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the
powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:‑‑
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.‑‑(1)
This Ordinance may be called Exchange Risk Coverage Ordinance, 1997.
(2) It extends to the whole of
Pakistan.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

Definitions

2. Definitions.‑‑In
this Ordinance, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context,‑‑
(a) "foreign currency"
means the foreign currency defined in the Foreign Exchange Regulation Act, 1947
(VII of 1947);
(b) "foreign exchange
circular" means any circular issued by the State Bank to provide foreign
exchange risk coverage and include those circulars which were issued before the
commencement of this Ordinance;
(c) "foreign currency
loan" means a loan in foreign currency to which exchange risk coverage is
available under any foreign exchange circular issued by the State Bank from
time to time; and
(d) "State Bank" means the
State Bank of Pakistan as defined in the State Bank of Pakistan Act, 1956
(XXXIII of 1956).

Validation of certain orders

Now, therefore, in exercise of the

3. Validation of certain orders.‑‑Notwithstanding
anything contained in any other law for the time being in force, or any
decision of any Court or any contract or any other instrument, for the purpose
of any foreign exchange circular issued by the State Bank for foreign exchange
risk coverage for any foreign currency loans, the expression
"contract" used in any such circular shall mean an agreement executed
by the parties thereto, and notwithstanding that such contract was legally
enforceable or had been approved by the Textile Commissioner or any other
authority, an order refusing the request for registration of contract executed
prior to the 16th day of May, 1982, for the purpose of registration of exchange
risk coverage shall be deemed to have been validly made and such request for
registration shall be deemed to have been validly refused and shall be deemed
always to have had effect accordingly.

Ordinance or any order made thereunder, shall not be called in question in any
Court on any ground whatsoever.

may, for the removal of difficulty in the operation of the provisions of this
Ordinance, or on the application of any person facing hardship by reason of
operation of those provisions, make such order or issue such directive as it
may deem fit and such order or direction shall have effect and be final.
